title: Unique normalized ambient tensor comparison
statement: Let ell be prime and E a finite extension of Q_ell. For any scheme map f:X→Y, choose a positive finite coefficient level or the whole ringed sequence site, and the exact module inverse image constructed in [lem-sf-ambient-pullback-site-constructions]. Fix closed derived tensor structures A,B with representative models TA,TB [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. There exists a unique BundledTensorComparison K for this inverse image [def-sf-bundled-tensor-comparison] satisfying TensorData.Normalized: the pure scalar-generator formula, naturality in both ordinary module arguments, invertibility of each total-complex comparison and preservation of flat-term K-flat representatives. All coefficient, object and Hom universes remain independent as in the constructions. The definitions and hypotheses are as in [def-sf-ordinary-tensor-pullback-data].

source.place: Tags 03D3 and 03EL; sites.tex 03CB; sites-cohomology.tex 06YN, 06YS, 07A4, 0G7E and 0G7D. Specialized construction and proof from the ambient coherence argument.

proof.text: Apply sitePullbackTensorGenerators on the chosen site, using representable flatness of base change. In the sequence case the relevant structured-arrow category is a product with the identity-index structured-arrow category, hence cofiltered. Totalize and descend with IndependentTensorModel.modelOfOrdinary, then bundle the resulting comparison and its model. Transport the pure-section normalization by one_smul. Ordinary uniqueness and TensorModelUniqueness.bundled_unique identify all normalized bundles.

proof_origin.place: Explicit specialization and glue for the cited adjunction, tensor and K-flat arguments; no change to the unit route.

theorem tensorData_existsUnique {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (s : Option ℕ)
    (A : Tensor ell E Y s) (B : Tensor ell E X s)
    (TA : TensorModels ell E Y s A) (TB : TensorModels ell E X s B) :
    ∃! K : TensorData ell E f s A B TA TB, K.Normalized ell E f s A B TA TB
